import base64,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
REPO='BestNameYet/Terminals'
SOURCE_COMMENT=6657091896
PATHS=[
 ('workspaces/programs-srs-design/SCREEN-EVENT-FSM-SRS.md','___FSM_DOC_MARKDOWN___'),
 ('workspaces/programs-srs-design/SCREEN-EVENT-FSM-SRS.agent.json','___FSM_DOC_JSON___')
]
def gh(method,endpoint,data=None,allow_error=False):
 args=['gh','api',f'repos/{REPO}/'+endpoint]
 if method!='GET':args+=['-X',method]
 if data is not None:args+=['--input','-']
 r=subprocess.run(args,input=json.dumps(data) if data is not None else None,text=True,capture_output=True)
 if r.returncode and not allow_error: raise RuntimeError(f'gh api {method} {endpoint}: {r.stderr[:700]}')
 return r if allow_error else json.loads(r.stdout)
source=gh('GET',f'issues/comments/{SOURCE_COMMENT}')
assert source['id']==SOURCE_COMMENT and source['user']['login']=='BestNameYet'
assert source['created_at']==source['updated_at']
entry=json.loads(source['body'])
assert entry['forWhom']=='GPT6_0000000857-fsm_srs_commit-Terminals' and entry['runOn']=='$'
original=entry['whatPrompt']
assert len(original)==32566 and original.startswith('set -euo pipefail')
data={}
for path,marker in PATHS:
 start=f"cat > '{path}' <<'{marker}'\n"
 assert original.count(start)==1,path
 rest=original.split(start,1)[1]
 end='\n'+marker+'\n'
 assert end in rest,path
 contents=rest.split(end,1)[0]+'\n'
 data[path]=contents.encode('utf-8')
assert data[PATHS[0][0]].startswith(b'# Screen')
j=json.loads(data[PATHS[1][0]])
assert j['id']=='PROG-FSM-SRS-001' and j['version']=='0.1.0'
assert j['source_markdown']==PATHS[0][0]
assert j['provenance']['extraction_run_id']==42019837848
assert len(j['verification']['test_ids'])==14
assert len(set(x['id'] for x in j['invariants']))==len(j['invariants'])
assert 'application agnostic' in data[PATHS[0][0]].decode('utf-8')
assert Path('workspaces/programs-srs-design').is_dir()
assert Path('AGENTS.md').is_file()
print('SOURCE_AND_DOCUMENTS_VALIDATED',[(p,len(b),hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()) for p,b in data.items()],flush=True)
for path in data:
 result=gh('GET','contents/'+path,allow_error=True)
 if result.returncode==0:raise RuntimeError('Refusing to overwrite existing '+path)
 if '404' not in result.stderr:raise RuntimeError('Cannot verify absence '+path+': '+result.stderr[:500])
blobs={}
for path,content in data.items():
 blob=gh('POST','git/blobs',{'content':base64.b64encode(content).decode('ascii'),'encoding':'base64'})
 blobs[path]=blob['sha']
print('GIT_BLOBS_CREATED',blobs,flush=True)
commit_sha=None
for attempt in range(1,4):
 ref=gh('GET','git/ref/heads/main')
 parent=ref['object']['sha']
 prev=gh('GET','git/commits/'+parent)
 tree=gh('POST','git/trees',{'base_tree':prev['tree']['sha'],'tree':[{'path':p,'mode':'100644','type':'blob','sha':sha} for p,sha in blobs.items()]})
 commit=gh('POST','git/commits',{'message':'docs(programs): draft application-agnostic screen-event FSM SRS','tree':tree['sha'],'parents':[parent]})
 upd=gh('PATCH','git/refs/heads/main',{'sha':commit['sha'],'force':False},allow_error=True)
 if upd.returncode==0:
  commit_sha=commit['sha']
  break
 if '409' not in upd.stderr and '422' not in upd.stderr:
  raise RuntimeError('Failed to publish commit: '+upd.stderr[:500])
 print('REFERENCE_CONFLICT_RETRY',attempt,flush=True)
if not commit_sha:raise RuntimeError('Push conflict after three attempts')
print('PUBLISHED_COMMIT',commit_sha,flush=True)
for path,local in data.items():
 remote=gh('GET','contents/'+path)
 actual=base64.b64decode(remote['content'])
 assert actual==local,('byte mismatch',path)
 assert remote['sha']==blobs[path],('blob mismatch',path)
 print('REMOTE_VERIFIED',path,len(actual),hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(),remote['sha'],flush=True)
print('SRS_PUBLICATION_VERIFIED',commit_sha,flush=True)
